01 · Content · Live and digital

Outloud

Live in the room. Shared on screen.

The conversations we have in public. Live formats bring founders, investors and operators into one room to share real stories and work through real questions. Digital content carries those conversations across MENA, in episodes, short reels, VW Notes and the VW Newsletter.

02 · Education · Practical and dynamic

The Venture School

Learn it in practice. Lead it in motion.

Experience-driven education for every seat at the table: founders, angels, mentors, intrapreneurs and career professionals. Each topic is taught from every stakeholder's side, through role play, real case studies from the region, games and guest practitioners, so you leave with frameworks you use the next day.

  • Programs and bootcamps
  • Masterclasses
  • Workshops
  • Mentorship
  • Open cohorts
  • Programs for teams and partners

03 · Services · Fractional leadership

BRICKR

We don't consult and leave. We build together.

Experienced partners embedded in your venture or portfolio: in the decisions, in the work, and measured by what it produces, not by hours of advice. We launch, rebalance and grow ventures, and build the structure behind portfolios and innovation hubs.

  • Fractional leadership
  • Venture building and scaling
  • Portfolio infrastructure
  • Innovation hubs

QuidQuo

Less friction between capital and the people who need it.

An agentic AI platform in development that helps founders and investors build their ventures and portfolios, with capital formation as the goal. Follow the build on the platform and join the waitlist to be first in.

Open Floor.

Real stories. Open discussion.

An interactive business session where we share and discuss real venture stories from every side of the table, and the room brings its own experiences and questions. One topic, two hours, hosted by Ahmed Fouad and Karim Hemdan, with expert guests for specific topics.

1
topic per session
2 h
live, in two rounds
8–10
stories & questions
  1. Scan to joinA QR code on screen. No app.
  2. ShareShare stories & questions, named or anonymous.
  3. The PickStories & questions drawn at random, on screen.
  4. DiscussionStories & questions discussed together, to a clear take or next step.

Who we are

Two ecosystem builders. Built in Cairo, working across MENA.

Combined, we bring 30+ years of experience across different industries, stages and markets, and every space is run hands-on by the two of us.

  • Venture building
  • Venture operations
  • Investment & fund management
  • Consulting
  • Ecosystem building
Co-founder & Managing Partner

Ahmed Fouad

Operator, investor and advisor. Ahmed built and ran ventures including Easy Taxi, Yumamia, Akelni, Tabibi and Toggar, invests through SeaSand CVC and DINARe Ventures, and advises founders through Sweetspot and the GLG council.

LinkedIn
Co-founder & Managing Partner

Karim Hemdan

Operator, investor and advisor. Karim learned the venture playbook at Rocket Internet in Berlin and ran operations at Easy Taxi, Yumamia, Jumia Group and Delivery Hero (Talabat). He invests through SeaSand CVC and DINARe Ventures and is a 500 Global VC Unlocked fellow.
